page.title: Home
page.description: PolIDS (Polish Integrated Display System) is the VATSIM PL vACC controller display for FIR EPWW. This pass restyles the shell and every existing view to match the user's PANDORA references; routes, data and behaviour are unchanged. The default view is HOME (the ? key). Its one h1 is the controller's personal greeting, followed by the VATSIM connection and bookings, the position choice and the SELF CHECK-IN key. Step 2 holds the check-in panels.

architecture.contract: This screen answers: which position am I opening, and is anything booked or in force that I must know before I plug in? Face: the PolIDS key panel, flat green keys on black with rows locked across both columns (brand signatureDevice). The finding is read first, in the VATSIM lines under the greeting (for example 'Booking: EPWA_APP 16:00–18:00Z' while not yet connected), directly above the Position panel and its SELF CHECK-IN key.
architecture.grid:
Shell at 1440: menu column 150 (137 key + 2 x 1.5 margin + 2 x 4.5 padding + 1 rule) + submenu column 150 + pane 1140 = 1440. Views without a submenu have a 1290 pane. Default pane padding 12/16 leaves 1108 of content.

Per view at 1440:
- AERODROME INFO (padding 8/12): 232 + 8 + 506.3 (1.4fr) + 8 + 361.7 (1fr) = 1116.
- HOME (padding 24): step 1 is a 780 column centred, 231 + 780 + 231 = 1242. SELF CHECK-IN is 272 + 8 + 556.5 + 8 + 397.5 = 1242.

At 1366: 150 + 150 + 1066. AERODROME 232 + 8 + 463.2 + 8 + 330.8 = 1042; SELF CHECK-IN 272 + 8 + 513.3 + 8 + 366.7 = 1168.

At 1920: 150 + 150 + 1620.

Vertical at 1366x768: 18 top bar + 9 column padding + 21 rows x 31 + 80 foot = 758 <= 768. With a signed-in controller the foot is 146 and keys shrink evenly to about 25.3 px.

One 8 px gap everywhere.
architecture.signatureRule: The PANDORA key panel is the move. Menu and submenu are two columns of flat #207a11 keys standing on pure black, rows aligned across both, exactly one #5fd23a active key per column. Right of the keys there is only data on black, plus paper-white boxes for frequencies, maps, the aircraft sheet and the touch keyboard. The dealt framed-sheet move (tinted L-frame, inset white sheet, 16 px corners) is not applied, because user references 1-11 and the locked brand outrank it.
architecture.rhythm:
High density, three settings moved together:
- keys: 28 px on a 31 px pitch at 14 px uppercase
- data rows: 22-26 px at 15 px (TAF, GAMET, NOTAM text); METAR table at 18px/1.45 (26 px rows); AERODROME list rows 38 px at 20 px
- table cells: 4px 8px at a 13 px body
- padding: pane 12px 16px (AERODROME 8px 12px, HOME 24px), one 8 px gap

navigationDesign.layout: An 18 px top bar spans the window (Reload | Brighter | Darker). Under it, the 150 px menu column holds 21 key rows on a 31 px pitch: ←, then the 20 tabs. At its foot sit the UTC clock with the AIRAC line, the PolIDS Poland mark and the user box. Each view adds its own 150 px submenu column, keys row for row beside the menu (letter pairs on CALLSIGN and AIRCRAFT), then the pane. Keys are the only navigation: no icons, no labelled sidebar, no anchors into a view.
behavior: One tap on a menu key opens its view at #<tab>. That key fills #5fd23a and the pane swaps at 0 ms.
A submenu key opens its page at #<tab>/<id> and becomes its column's one active key.
← and browser Back step through this session's screens (Alt+←). ← is disabled at 35% opacity on the first screen.
Reload returns to the same screen; F5 opens HOME.
Brighter and Darker step brightness by 12% from -2 to +2 and are remembered.
ADMIN is present only for administrators.
Long submenus (AD VFR with 69 aerodromes) scroll by whole rows with snap and no visible scrollbar.
In short windows keys shrink evenly to a 16 px minimum, so all 21 rows fit beside the foot.

transformation.compact: Below 641 px is out of scope: controllers use 1366-1920 px monitors and tablets. The desktop shell stays as today; no phone fold is added.
transformation.medium: 641-1100 px: both key columns keep 150 px. Panes use their existing breakpoints (1250, 1240, 1150 and 1100 px) to drop to two columns or stack. Touch works with 28 px keys and 40-44 px keyboard keys.
transformation.expanded: 1101 px and up: as laid out. At 1920x1080 the panes widen and RADIO scales its board.

sections.purpose: Name the product and keep every view one tap away, beside the UTC time, the AIRAC cycle and the signed-in controller.
sections.userQuestion: Where is the data I need, and what time and AIRAC cycle am I working in?
evidence: user-reference-10: two columns of flat green keys on black, active key brighter, EMERGENCY red
user-reference-2: menu keys with white uppercase labels on black
frontend/index.html menu order; style.css key metrics (issue #25); brand signatureDevice

copy.heading: PolIDS
body: Top bar: Reload, Brighter, Darker.
Menu keys: ←, ?, RADIO, METEO, AWALON, AERODROME, AD CIV, AD MIL, AD VFR, INOP, CALLSIGN, AIRCRAFT, MAP, COORDINATION, CONVERSION, SYT OP, AUP, OTHER, ABOUT, EMERGENCY, and ADMIN for administrators.
Sample data: the menu foot reads 14:32:07Z and AIRAC 2611 · 2026-10-29 – 2026-11-25, then the PolIDS Poland mark, then the signed-in controller with '1458203 · C1' and Log out.

sections.layout:
Body grid auto | 1fr under the 18 px top bar (unchanged).

Top bar: three equal flat #207a11 fields 2 px apart, 12px/18px white labels, tracking 0, no gradient.

Menu column: 150 px on #000 (retire #050605). 21 key rows at 137x28 with 1.5 px margins on a 31 px pitch. Keys are flat #207a11 with a 1px #1f5a16 edge and 14px uppercase white labels at 400, tracking 0 (retire .3px). Variants:
- active: #5fd23a fill with a #0b2a06 label
- SYT OP: label #ccff66
- EMERGENCY: #b3261e, active #e0302a with a white label
- ADMIN: flat #3a3a3a
- ←: 22px glyph, 35% when disabled

Foot: 80 px. Clock box 46 px (20px white UTC, 12px #a3a3a3 AIRAC line), then the 34 px mark. With a signed-in controller add the 66 px user box: name #e8e8e8, 'CID · rating' #a3a3a3, DEV #f2d21b, Log out as a secondary button. Foot rules are 1px #2a2a2a.

Submenu column: 150 px on #000, keys row for row with the menu, gap rows where the code puts them. The long-submenu column drawing is recoloured to #000 and #2a2a2a.

Rules: none between the key columns. One 1px #2a2a2a rule stands before the pane. Keep both 1px borders for the width sums: the menu's border is #000 when a submenu follows and #2a2a2a when none does.

motion.behavior: Pointerdown fills the key #5fd23a with a #0b2a06 label at 0 ms. Release returns it over 120 ms unless it stays selected. Hover on hover-capable pointers lights the 1px edge #5fd23a over 120 ms. The view swap is instant.
motion.reducedMotion: Every transition at 0 ms; identical final states and operation.

transformation.compact: Out of scope below 641 px; unchanged.
transformation.medium: Both columns keep 150 px. Keys shrink evenly to 16 px in short tablet windows.

sections.purpose: Show who is signed in, whether they are connected and what is booked, and put the check-in for the right position one tap away.
sections.userQuestion: Am I connected, what is booked for me, and which position am I opening?

copy.heading: Welcome, Anna Nowak (1458203)
body: Sample data: rating line 'C1 · Enroute Controller'.

VATSIM, the finding read first: 'You are not connected to VATSIM as a controller.' above 'Booking: EPWA_APP 16:00–18:00Z'. With nothing booked it reads 'No bookings in the next 24 h.' Bookings refresh every minute.

Position: EPWA_APP taken from the booking, with the note 'Warszawa Approach · 128.800 · aerodromes: EPWA, EPMO · booking 16:00–18:00Z' and the SELF CHECK-IN key under it. A tower position turns the key into 'SELF CHECK-IN → AERODROME EPWA'.
Foot: the version and 'AIRAC 2611 · 2026-10-29 – 2026-11-25'.

sections.layout:
HOME pane (no submenu): 1290 px at 1440 with 24 px padding. One 780 px column, centred horizontally (231 + 780 + 231 = 1242) and vertically, items 12 px apart.

Greeting: the h1 at 22px #ffffff, weight 400 (from 44px; the 30px and 32px media overrides go). Rating: 13px small caps #a3a3a3 (from green with .5px tracking).

VATSIM and Position are panels: 1px #2a2a2a frame, no fill, title in the label style over a 1px #1a1a1a rule (retire the #111611 band). VATSIM lines are 14px: online and booking in #5fd23a, 'not connected' and 'No bookings…' in #a3a3a3, errors #ff6a5a.

Position select: full width, 28px or taller, #141414 fill with a 1px #5a5a5a edge. Note: 12px #a3a3a3 with the booking in #5fd23a. SELF CHECK-IN: a full-width primary key.

Foot: version and AIRAC at 12px #a3a3a3, centred at the pane bottom.

motion.behavior: The select's focus edge turns #5fd23a. SELF CHECK-IN gives press feedback and then swaps to step 2 at 0 ms. VATSIM lines update in place on refresh.
motion.reducedMotion: 0 ms; same final states.

transformation.compact: Out of scope below 641 px; unchanged.
transformation.medium: The column narrows to the pane width minus padding; panels stack as today.
transformation.expanded: 780 px column centred in the pane at every desktop width.

sections.purpose: Give the controller everything to check before opening the position, in one screen.
sections.userQuestion: What is in force at my aerodromes right now: transition level, weather, LVP, NOTAMs and flow restrictions?
evidence: frontend/js/overview.js panels: Transition level, METAR · TAF · LVP, NOTAMs in force now, Flow restrictions, Airport monitor, Position opening checklist

copy.heading: SELF CHECK-IN
body: Sample data: Transition level FL080 as the one large figure. It becomes FL090 only when an aerodrome reports QNH 995 hPa or lower; TA 6500 ft.
METAR · TAF · LVP per aerodrome of the position. Each shows the ATIS runway with its letter, or the preferred runway in a dashed PREF frame, with ARR and DEP apart when they differ.
NOTAMs in force now; Flow restrictions (ECFMP and vIFF); Airport monitor (vIFF); and the Position opening checklist for APP or ACC. MINE or ALL, with 'N hidden'.
Empty lines as written today: 'No NOTAMs in force now for the aerodromes shown.' and 'No flow measures for FIR EPWW and Polish aerodromes.'

sections.layout:
Same HOME pane. First a bar: '← CHANGE POSITION' as a secondary button, the position, then MINE/ALL with 'N hidden' in #a3a3a3.

Grid: 272 + 8 + 556.5 + 8 + 397.5 = 1242 at 1440; 272 + 8 + 513.3 + 8 + 366.7 = 1168 at 1366. At <=1240 px wide or <=640 px tall it becomes 272 + 1.4fr and the HOME pane scrolls.

Panels: 1px #2a2a2a frame, no fill, label-style titles. Transition level is the one large figure: 28px #ffffff at 400. PREF uses a 1px dashed #a3a3a3 frame. Restrictions use the square tag pairs. NOTAM and METAR rows are banded #000/#2b2b2b. Checklist rows are 13px.

MINE/ALL: square segments; on is a #14240f fill with #5fd23a text, off is #a3a3a3.

motion.behavior: MINE and ALL: the on fill moves to the chosen segment over 120 ms while the rows filter at once and keep their order. The module-load error shows its message and TRY AGAIN inside the pane.
motion.reducedMotion: The segment changes at 0 ms; rows and final states are identical.

transformation.compact: Out of scope below 641 px; unchanged.
transformation.medium: Two columns (272 + 1.4fr) with the pane scrolling, as today at <=1240 px.
transformation.expanded: Three columns summing to the pane width, as above.

sections.purpose: Show who is on which frequency across EPWW and its neighbours on one board.
sections.userQuestion: Who is online on which frequency, in which sector configuration, and where is nobody staffing?
evidence: user-reference-6: white frequency boxes, cyan unit labels, yellow sector tags on black

copy.heading: RADIO
body: Sample data: the top row shows ACC GAT '2N', APP GD '1', APP WA 'H+L', APP KK '1' and APP PO '0'. The Polish ATIS boxes follow, such as 'EPWA ATIS DEP 123.430', with '+2' when they overflow.

Neighbour tiles with yellow FIR codes EDWW, EDUU, EDMM, ESAA, LKAA, LZBB, UMKK, EYVL, UMMV and UKLV. Staffed sectors appear as white frequency boxes, 'ADVISORY 122.800' marks an unstaffed FIR, and 'BERLIN: EAST' sits under EDWW. Level bands are 660, 365 and 0.
Black EPWW previews LOW FL330, MID FL350 and HIGH FL400 with labels such as 'B LOW' and 'I FIS'. A red sector means a vIFF restriction or more than 80 % of capacity.
'Data from 14:28Z (4 min old)' once data ages past 3 min. 'retrying every 30 s' appears after a failed first load.

sections.layout:
No submenu. The board keeps its owner-tuned 13-column grid (radioboard.js pageGrid, --rb-f 11-15 px by window) across the 1290 px pane, unchanged.

Only shared finishes change:
- column H layer keys are flat (#207a11 with white labels when on, the existing off grey when off)
- FMP stays black with a grey edge
- no gradients

Preserved from radio.css: white frequency boxes with dark figures, #f2d21b FIR codes and sector tags, #3ec7e0 unit labels, the navy outlines and the red capacity fills.

motion.behavior: A layer key's on or off fill changes over 120 ms while its layer shows or hides at once. A FIR code opens its LoA panel at once. Data refresh replaces values in place without a flash.
motion.reducedMotion: Key fills change at 0 ms; layers and values are identical.

transformation.compact: Out of scope below 641 px; unchanged.
transformation.medium: --rb-f drops to 11 px and the 820 px height rule compacts rows, as today.
transformation.expanded: --rb-f up to 15 px at 1920x1080. The whole grid fits windows 821-1000 px tall.

sections.purpose: Show the current METAR of every aerodrome in a list, colour-coded the way PANDORA does.
sections.userQuestion: What is the weather at each aerodrome right now, and which report is missing?
evidence: user-reference-3: METAR rows on black, white values, yellow CAVOK, dim green time and RMK groups, alternating bands

copy.heading: METAR PL
body: Sample data: the 15 AD 2 IFR aerodromes in a fixed order, one per row, for example 'EPWA 231030Z 27012KT CAVOK 08/02 Q1017 NOSIG' and 'EPKK 231030Z 24008KT 9999 FEW030 07/01 Q1018 NOSIG'. A missing report reads 'NIL'.
DECODED adds the weather in English and Polish inline, for example '-RA[LIGHT RAIN / LEKKI DESZCZ]'.
METAR MIL and METAR INTL use the same rows with a search field. COLOURED / MONO and DECODED / RAW are shared by all five lists and remembered.

sections.layout:
Submenu: METAR PL, METAR MIL, METAR INTL, TAF PL, TAF INTL, WIND, RADAR, GAMET, SIGWX, a gap row, ICING, QNH, SAT EUR, SAT PL, TURB, SUN.

Pane (1108 px): one toolbar row with COLOURED / MONO and DECODED / RAW as text switches (on #5fd23a, off in the red they use today), 'refresh every 2 min' in small caps, and the search on MIL and INTL.

Table: 18px/1.45 (26 px rows), narrow white station column, groups coloured as metarfmt.js assigns them today. The cloud colour --mt-cov moves from #24802a to #4cae3a. Rows alternate #000 and #2b2b2b with no rules and no header band.

Fit: 15 PL rows take 390 px, so list and toolbar fit 1440x900 and 1366x768 without scrolling.

motion.behavior: COLOURED / MONO and DECODED / RAW: the chosen option's colour changes over 120 ms while the rows re-render at once. The 2-minute refresh replaces rows in place; rows never re-enter or flash.
motion.reducedMotion: Switch colours change at 0 ms; rows are identical.

transformation.compact: Out of scope below 641 px; unchanged.
transformation.medium: Rows keep one line and the pane scrolls horizontally inside the list only if a long INTL report needs it.
transformation.expanded: Full rows with the decode inline.

Leaflet zoom bar: square with a 1px #9aa0a6 edge and no shadow. The caption with the time sits under the map in the label style.

copy.heading: SAT EUR

RADAR, SIGWX, SAT PL and TURB use the same stage. TURB steps from +0 to +21 h with playback, and ICING covers FL050 to FL300.
A failed frame shows 'No preview' in its place.

sections.layout: Image stage at full pane width on #000: square, no shadow or overlay. Caption: 13px small caps #a3a3a3 under the image with its UTC time. Step keys form one row of square segments (active: #14240f fill, #5fd23a text, 2 px underline; failed: #ff6a5a). TURB playback controls are secondary buttons.

WIND shows the wind map at the chosen level and reads 'Forecast unavailable.' when the forecast fails.

sections.purpose: Show the wind profile from the surface to 10 000 ft for every AD 2 aerodrome.
sections.userQuestion: How strong is the wind at each level over each aerodrome, and what does it mean for its runways?

copy.heading: AWALON
body: Sample data: ALL shows wind from SFC to 10 000 ft every 1000 ft for the 15 AD 2 aerodromes, for example EPWA SFC 270/12 kt from the METAR and 260/28 kt at 3000 ft. Cells are coloured by speed band (0–10, 10–15, 15–20, 20–30, 30–40, 40–60, over 60 kt) unless colours are off, and rows below the aerodrome read GND.
Per aerodrome: the profile chart, the profile table (direction, speed, gust, minimum and maximum within ±1 h) and 'Runways · 0 ft and 3000 ft approach'.
Empty: 'No wind profile for EPZG'.

sections.layout: Submenu: ALL plus the 15 aerodromes. ALL is one table across the pane: header in the label style, cells on the preserved awalon.css palette, white figures, tabular alignment. Per aerodrome, the chart, profile table and runway panel keep their palette; only frames, headers and bands change. The SFC forecast stays in italics where there is no METAR.

copy.heading: EPWW
body: Sample data: the EPWW list has one aerodrome per row, for example 'EPWA LOTNISKO CHOPINA W WARSZAWIE' with TWR and APP online tags and 'EPKK KRAKÓW/Balice', with MIL marked on military fields. The count reads '57 aerodromes', or '3 of 57' while a search filters it.

A foreign aerodrome opens a card with METAR, TAF, ATIS and its APP, TWR, GND, DEL and ATIS positions.

sections.layout:
Submenu: (), EPWW, ESAA, ED, ET, LKAA, LZBB, UMKK, EYVL, UMMV, UKLV. Pane 1116 px (padding 8px 12px).

Bar:

- SHOW and CLEAR as primary keys

sections.purpose: Put one Polish aerodrome on one screen: weather, wind, runways, ATIS, NOTAMs and frequencies.
sections.userQuestion: What is the weather, runway in use and staffing at this aerodrome?
evidence: frontend/js/tabs/aerodrome.js titles: ATIS, Frequencies · online · bookings, NOTAM, Runways, TAF, Traffic, Wind 0 / 3000 ft · approach

copy.heading: EPWA
body: Sample data: METAR head 'EPWA 231030Z 27012KT CAVOK 08/02 Q1017 NOSIG'. 'Wind 0 / 3000 ft · approach' shows 270/12 kt at 0 ft and 260/28 kt at 3000 ft with runway 29 in use. 'Runways' lists 11/29 and 15/33.

'Frequencies · online · bookings' shows EPWA_TWR 118.300 online in bright green and EPWA_APP 128.800 booked with a dashed edge. 'ATIS', 'NOTAM' and 'TAF' follow. LVP reads 'LVP CANCELLED' or 'LVP not applicable'.

Toolbar: the ICAO field with Show, then INFO / AWOS / TRAFFIC as square segments (active: #14240f fill, #5fd23a text, 2 px underline). The METAR head line comes next.

Grid: 232 + 8 + 506.3 + 8 + 361.7 = 1116 at 1440; 463.2 and 330.8 at 1366; two columns at <=1250 px or <=640 px tall. Panels use label-style titles with no bands.

Figures: wind rose 200 px; wind figure 28px white (from 26px); runway pair 28px (from 32px).

Frequency boxes: white with 15px black figures and a 2px #9cdc84 edge; online fills #8cff5a; booked gets a 2px dashed #ffb020 edge. The runway table stays centred and banded.

motion.behavior: INFO, AWOS and TRAFFIC: the active segment and its underline move over 120 ms while the content swaps at once. Data refresh replaces values in place.

sections.purpose: Show live runway sensors and the departure and arrival sequence for the aerodrome.
sections.userQuestion: What do the runway sensors read, and which flights depart and arrive next?

copy.heading: TRAFFIC

interactions:
Menu, submenu and letter keys:
- rest: flat #207a11
- hover (hover-capable pointers): the 1px edge lights #5fd23a over 120 ms
- pointerdown: fills #5fd23a with a #0b2a06 label at 0 ms; release returns over 120 ms unless selected
- active: stays filled with aria-current ('page' in the menu, 'true' in submenus)
- focus-visible: 2px #ffffff outline inset 2px
- disabled: ← on the first screen at 35%
Rapid repeated taps on keys always leave exactly one active key per column and never a stuck pressed fill.
Top bar Reload, Brighter, Darker: same press and hover. Brighter and Darker disable at 45% at +2 and -2 and their titles show the brightness percentage.

Rows in lists and tables:
- hover: a 1px #5fd23a edge round the row, fill unchanged
- select (click, tap or Enter): a full-width #a51d16 band with white text, detail opens in place
- arrows, PgUp and PgDn move the selection in the AERODROME list
- focus-visible: 2px #ffffff outline inside the row

Switches (MINE/ALL, INFO/AWOS/TRAFFIC, SECTORS/SCENARIOS, GAMET areas, image steps, layer keys, sort segments): on is a #14240f fill with #5fd23a text or the existing 2 px underline, off is #a3a3a3. The on state moves to the chosen option over 120 ms while the content changes at 0 ms. States stay remembered where the code already remembers them. METAR's COLOURED/MONO and DECODED/RAW keep their green-on and red-off text.

Fields and selects:
- rest: #141414 fill, 1px #5a5a5a edge, #e8e8e8 text, placeholder #a3a3a3
- focus: edge #5fd23a over 120 ms
- disabled: 35%
- paper search fields: #ffffff, #1b1c20 text, placeholder #5a5a5a

Touch keyboard: () toggles it (aria-pressed, existing). The tray opens and closes over 120 ms (6 px rise plus opacity). Escape closes it and returns focus to its search field. Keys type at the cursor, and CLEAR, SPACE and BACKSPACE are wide keys.
Tooltips (data-tip and map labels): #0d0d0d fill, 1px #5a5a5a edge, 12px text. They appear on hover with no delay or motion.

Data refresh (METAR every 2 min when enabled, bookings every minute, RADIO and DMAN feeds): values replace in place with no flash, count-up or re-entrance. RADIO adds 'Data from HH:MMZ (N min old)' after 3 min.
Navigation: ← and Alt+← return to the previous screen of this session, Reload returns to the same screen, and F5 opens HOME.
EMERGENCY: opening the view draws the 3px red frame at once; leaving the view removes it.
Reduced motion: prefers-reduced-motion sets every transition to 0 ms with identical final states and the same operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Scope: only frontend/css files change. The one exception is aria-current on the active menu and submenu keys, set where app.js and api.js already toggle .active. No route, API, data, markup structure or behaviour changes, and grid columns, key metrics and row pitches stay as they are.

Tokens in style.css :root:
- --bg #000; --panel #0d0d0d; --panel-2 #141414; --line #2a2a2a
- --text #e8e8e8; --muted #a3a3a3
- --green #207a11; --green-dark #1f5a16; --green-hi and --ok #5fd23a; --green-text #5fd23a
- --yellow and --warn #f2d21b; --bad #ff6a5a; --cyan #3ec7e0; --menu-lime #ccff66
- --row and --list-row #000; --row-alt and --list-row-alt #2b2b2b; --sel #a51d16
- the EMERGENCY frame and active EMERGENCY key use #e0302a
- --head and --head-line no longer fill panel titles or table headers; --row-hover and --list-row-hover no longer fill rows

No fill gradients: grep frontend/css for 'linear-gradient(' finds only the hard-stop column drawing in style.css (recoloured to #000 and #2a2a2a) and repeating-linear-gradient hatches. Keys, the top bar, section bars, dm-top, dm-acts, .lg legend chips and the admin key are flat.

No 3 px left bar remains on h2.title, selected rows or about tiles.
